mapper.select: SELECT SEQ_NO as code, BATCH_NAME as name, BATCH_NAME as shortName FROM SYS_BATCH_GRP WHERE BATCH_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{taskGroup, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') ORDER BY PRE_BATCH_GROUP, SEQ_NO

SELECT TASK_ID as code, TASK_NAME as name, TASK_NAME as shortName FROM SYS_BATCH_TASK WHERE TASK_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{task, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') ORDER BY to_number(FTASK_ID), to_number(TASK_ID)

SELECT distinct grp.SEQ_NO as code, grp.GROUP_NAME as name, grp.GROUP_NAME as shortName FROM SYS_BATCH_PRD_GRP grp
inner join sys_batch_grp_prdlink sbgpl on grp.seq_no=sbgpl.group_seq inner join data_auth_notify_inst dani on sbgpl.product_id=dani.business_id and dani.data_type='V08' and dani.institution_code
#{item}
WHERE grp.GROUP_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{param, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') ORDER BY grp.SEQ_NO

SELECT A.SEQ_NO, B.TASK_NAME, to_char(A.EXECUTE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') batchDate, A.TASK_STATUS, C.LOG_INFO, D.BOOKSET_ID, D.FINPROD_ID, D.BUSI_ID, D.RESULT_INFO, D.DETAIL_EX, D.FILE_PATH, D.EXE_SEQNO FROM SYS_BATCH_EXEC_INFO A LEFT JOIN SYS_BATCH_TASK B ON A.TASK_ID = B.TASK_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_BATCH_EXEC_LOG C ON A.SEQ_NO = C.SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN SYS_BATCH_DETAIL_LOG D ON A.SEQ_NO = D.EXE_SEQNO WHERE A.SEQ_NO = #{logSeqNo}
